title: Volleyball
tagline: Pick your role. Pass, set, spike and block.
description: Play one of six players on a volleyball team in real 3D: setter, outside hitter, middle blocker, opposite or libero. Run your player, time each touch and aim with a flick while the computer plays the other eleven. Five rival levels, role tutorials, Learn lessons, Think hints and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Choose your role, then drag to run your player.
When the ring closes on your player, lift your finger to pass, set, spike, serve or block.
Flick as you lift to aim: left, right, long or short.
Win sets to 25 (win by two); the deciding set goes to 15.
Tap Roles to see the rotation order.
